# Colour fixtures

This directory holds the committed colour set used by
`tests/integration/test_colour_palette.py`. It proves that palette separation
draws with many pens instead of collapsing a colour image to three. The photo
is committed, so the test never needs the network.

| File | What it is | Size | Source | Licence | Author | Rebuild command |
|------|------------|------|--------|---------|--------|-----------------|
| `generate_colour.py` | Deterministic generator for the synthetic blocks; no random input | 1.4 KB | Generated in this repository | MIT (this repository) | penpath contributors | `uv run python tests/fixtures/images/colour/generate_colour.py` |
| `colour_blocks.png` | 826x422 grid of red, green, yellow, orange, blue, purple and black blocks on white, with white gaps; one clear region per Stabilo hue family | 1.8 KB | Generated by `generate_colour.py` | MIT (this repository) | penpath contributors | `uv run python tests/fixtures/images/colour/generate_colour.py` |
| `christmas_tree.jpg` | 920x1160 crop of a decorated Christmas tree: green foliage, red tinsel and baubles, gold decorations and dark wall/shadow areas | 426 KB | [File:Christmas tree (22622).jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Christmas_tree_(22622).jpg) | CC0 | Maximden | See "Fetch and crop `christmas_tree.jpg`" below |
| `README.md` | This source, licence and rebuild record | 2 KB | Written for this repository | MIT (this repository) | penpath contributors | Edited by hand |

## Rebuild

Run these from the repository root.

### Synthetic blocks

```bash
uv run python tests/fixtures/images/colour/generate_colour.py
```

The script uses only NumPy and Pillow and takes no random input, so it rewrites
`colour_blocks.png` pixel for pixel. The block colours are the Stabilo 88 pen
colours from `src/penpath/presets/palettes.py`, which makes the seven regions
land on seven distinct pens.

### Fetch and crop `christmas_tree.jpg`

The Commons original is 2448x3264 and 3.3 MB. Download the 1280 px thumbnail,
crop to the tree (`x=140..1060`, `y=120..1280` in thumbnail coordinates) to
grow the red decorations' share, then re-encode:

```bash
curl -sSL -A "penpath-dev/0.1" -o /tmp/Christmas_tree_22622_1280.jpg \
  "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e7/Christmas_tree_%2822622%29.jpg/1280px-Christmas_tree_%2822622%29.jpg"
uv run python -c "from PIL import Image; im = Image.open('/tmp/Christmas_tree_22622_1280.jpg').convert('RGB'); im.crop((140, 120, 1060, 1280)).resize((920, 1160), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).save('tests/fixtures/images/colour/christmas_tree.jpg', quality=85, optimize=True)"
```

The result is 426 KB, below the 500 KB fixture limit. The image page, author
and licence are recorded above; CC0 needs no attribution but the source is
kept here for reproducibility.

## Measured shares

`palette_match` on the committed files with `--palette stabilo_88` gives the
blocks seven used pens (each about 10.36% of the image) and the tree:

| pen | share |
|-----|------:|
| `stabilo_88_red` | 3.87% |
| `stabilo_88_yellow` | 9.65% |
| `stabilo_88_black` | 6.10% |
| `stabilo_88_green` + `stabilo_88_light_green` | 7.85% |

The 2.0% floor is the same acceptance floor as LUC-115; the crop was chosen to
clear it, not the floor lowered to fit the photo.
